fal.webhookResultRetention: about 1 hour after completion, about 6 minutes for results of 10 KB or more
fal.perRequestCost: Billing Events API, GET https://api.fal.ai/v1/models/billing-events?request_id=..., field cost_total (USD) and cost_estimate_nano_usd. Needs a key with billing:usage:read. Lag not documented.
fal.failureBilling: No charge for HTTP 500+ or queue time. 422 (bad input, content_policy_violation) MAY be charged if GPU time was used.
